proposals.title: Scrolling flow: title tag + icon, dashed path to a lit progress ring, path on to a post card the cursor clicks
proposals.why: The whole DJ1 comp as a reusable explainer beat: a WORLD null scrolls down a two-branch diagram, one branch lights up and fills to a percentage, the route continues to a post card. Every text, colour, value and stop time is a knob.
proposals.call: trialRingsFlow(comp, {at, title: "Trial Reels", tagColor: "#2a8efd", icon, activeLabel: "Non-Followers", inactiveLabel: "Followers", value: 100, suffix: "%", views: "693K", button: "Post", side: "left", fillAt: 2.2333, fillDuration: 1.6667, scrollStops: [124.38, -972, -2135]})
proposals.overlaps: builds on parts dashedConnector, ringStat, countUp, focusBranch, scrollStops, titleTag, postCard, cursorClick, accentGlow, darkStage; no kit primitive covers it

proposals.title: Glowing dashed S-curve that draws itself between two nodes, over a dark ghost of the route
proposals.why: Path A / Path C: 2-vertex path with vertical tangents (±290/320), white stroke 20, dash 42 / gap 40.5, Deep Glow, Trim end 0→100 with a long soft landing (in 75–87 %); the ghost copies (#161616, same dashes) show the route before it lights.
proposals.call: dashedConnector(comp, {from: [x, y], to: [x, y], at, duration: 1.3, width: 20, dash: 42, gap: 40.5, ghost: true})
proposals.overlaps: none in the kit (no line/path primitive); pairs with accentGlow

proposals.title: Progress ring (base + fill) with a counter in the middle
proposals.why: Ring L Base (#646464, 22 px) + Ring L Fill (white→#dcdcdc gradient stroke, trim end = CTRL Progress×100, scale −100 % so it fills the other way, Deep Glow), counter and label inside/below, 344 px ring.
proposals.call: ringStat(comp, {value, label, at, duration, size: 344, x, y, mirror: true})
proposals.overlaps: same id as proposals.json ringStat; uses countUp

proposals.title: Number that counts up from a CTRL slider
proposals.why: Counter L Source Text = Math.round(Progress*100) + "%", Progress 0→1 over 2.233–3.9 s (out 57.1 %, in 80.8 %); Chalkduster 94 squeezed to 68 % width.

proposals.title: Light up the chosen option while the alternative stays dark
proposals.why: One CTRL 'Active' slider (0→1 in 0.3 s) drives opacity 11/15 % → 100 % on the chosen ring, counter and label (expressions 11 + 89*Active, 15 + 85*Active); the other side is drawn in near-black greys (#131313/#161616/#2c2c2c). Says 'this one, not that one'.
proposals.overlaps: DJ5 dimAway is the inverse (the losing option fades back); this lights the winner from a pre-dimmed state. Could share one 'emphasis' rig.

proposals.title: WORLD null that scrolls the scene vertically and stops on each stage
proposals.why: All layers parented to WORLD; its y goes 124.38 → (−30.87 at 1.1 s, no stop) → −972 (soft land, in 74.7 %), holds 2.6–3.43 s, then glides via −1577.77 to −2135 (in 45 %): a stop-and-go tour down a tall layout.
proposals.overlaps: proposals.json cameraDrift is a slow push/drift, not a stop-and-go scroll

proposals.title: Bold title on a flat colour highlight block
proposals.why: Label BG 521×101, roundness 4, #2a8efd with Deep Glow, under SF Pro Display Bold 107 white: a highlighter-style title tag.

proposals.title: Element lifts a little and shrinks to make room for what comes next
proposals.why: ICON null: y −19.7 px over 0.867–1.733 s (out 77.6 %, in 30.6 %) and scale 100 → 92.54 % over 1.0–2.2 s (out 62.3 %, in 53.2 %), while the icon fades in.
proposals.overlaps: follows pop / slideUp entrances; a separate 'make room' beat

proposals.title: Reels app glyph built from shape boolean ops, white with glow
proposals.why: Reels Icon: rounded square 369×368 (roundness 100) minus a 400×34 bar, two slanted stripes and a rounded 3-point polygon (radius 80) via Merge Paths Subtract; fades in 0→100 over 0.933 s (in 92.8 %).
proposals.overlaps: orb is the other hero shape, different look

proposals.title: Dark social post card with view count and Post / Trash buttons
proposals.why: Card 383×675 r14 #1c1c20 stroke #7a7a7a 2.5; eye icon + '693K' (SF Pro Bold 77); Post button 205×67 #077ae6 with #dce9f7 label; Trash button 113×67 #be171b with a white trash glyph.

proposals.title: Cursor that travels to a target and clicks
proposals.why: Cursor (Library) at 75 % glides from [+144.6, +288.4] to its target over 4.233–5.833 s on a curved path (out 40 %, in 80 %) while the hidden target null nudges 16 px onto the Post button (5.1–5.633 s, in 85 %).

proposals.title: Deep Glow on accent shapes and numbers
proposals.why: Deep Glow Radius 150, Spread 33, Exposure 0.02 on the dashed paths, ring fill, title tag and icon.

proposals.title: Near-black radial stage behind a scene
proposals.why: BG solid #050505 + Haze solid in Add mode with a Radial Ramp #050505 (centre [960, 540]) → #000 (at [1960, 540]), Scatter 50.
proposals.overlaps: same id as proposals.json darkStage; background
